result:
It's working — 11600 entities scanned, warn rules firing on terms without descriptions, validate rules firing on everything. The output is large because a 24h window catches the full graph (all files modified within that window based on mtime vs graph mtime).

Both modes work:
- `--entity ID` — evaluates all rules against one entity
- `--scan --since N` — evaluates all rules against recently changed entities

Built:

1. **`operations/engineering/fars/agentic/rules-engine/rules.json`** — 6 initial rules:
   - `propagate-on-completion` — fires propagate-dependencies when a task completes
   - `rollup-plan-status` — recomputes plan status when any child task changes
   - `warn-term-missing-description` — warns on terms without descriptions
   - `warn-task-missing-goal` — warns on tasks without goals
   - `archive-low-confidence-instinct` — archives instincts below 0.15 confidence
   - `validate-entity-frontmatter` — runs entity validation on any changed entity

2. **`operations/engineering/fars/agentic/tools/rule-engine.js`** — the engine (~200 lines):
   - Loads EAVT graph and materializes entities as attribute maps
   - Pattern matching: trigger keys must all match entity attributes (arrays = "one of")
   - Condition evaluation: JS expressions with `entity` in scope
   - `{{key}}` interpolation in action strings
   - Actions: `warn` (log only), shell commands (executed in tools/ dir with 30s timeout)
   - `--dry-run` mode for safe testing
   - `--list` mode to inspect loaded rules
   - JSON summary output on stdout for piping
